title: mexicat/pdoom-video
why_read: A creative code-rendered music video project, interesting as a generative-art/creative-coding piece but not a technical tool in itself.
analysis: This repository holds the code used to procedurally render a music video themed around AI-doom probability ('P(doom)'), likely using some kind of shader or generative graphics pipeline. It's the kind of creative-coding project that's fun to look at and might teach some rendering or animation tricks, but it isn't a reusable tool or research contribution. Its interest is mostly aesthetic and cultural rather than a broadly applicable engineering technique.
